column1: # rc.3's VirusTotal scan (run 43029170580, 2026-11-11), one line per unique
# Derived from that run's vt-scan-report-rc artifact (source, size) and its
# log: "reanalysing ... Ns ago" gives the age the lookup saw, and the
# "polling analysis of ..." lines give the polls each analysis took. The two
# reused files were analysed minutes before their lookup; 180 s stands for
# that. The run sent 108 requests: 31 lookups, 21 reanalyses, 13 upload
# requests (8 POST /files, and 5 GET /files/upload_url for files over 32 MB)
#   name    the file's base name; the two VSIXes' inner bin/nightgauge are
#   kind    text or binary, as vt-scan.sh decides it from the bytes
#   source  how rc.3 handled it: reused, reanalysed or uploaded
#   age     seconds from its last analysis to rc.3's lookup; - for a file
#   polls   polls its analysis took in rc.3; 0 for a reused file
# The replay makes one file per line, of the recorded kind. Only the size class
# (over or under 32 MB) changes a file's requests, so an over-32 MB file is
# made 32 MB + 1 byte and the rest are small.
